Source: user-supplied AI-Playable-Alien-main.zip, received 2026-11-07.
Archive SHA-256:
81585A8554AEADC18CB3845905F9076BF4A4FDDE1492ECD741378B9693DF408E

upstream/ retains the original source files used for this integration.
They are reference source, not a second DLL or an independently running mod.

AIMP build 435 adaptation map:
- camera.cpp ApplyFollow, FollowFromCfg, FpKeeperTick -> AlienPvPLocalController:
  actual FollowBehavior offsets and third-person flag, saved/restored per camera.
- camera.cpp OnFollowUpdateEnter/Leave, BackstageCamera -> scoped follow hook:
  living technical player computes mouse orbit backstage, translated to Alien.
- camera.cpp OnHkWorldEnter, DuctUpdate, Collide -> generation-scoped world
  observations, low-ceiling camera and three-ray soft collision.
- camera.cpp CamOffsetKeys -> input firewall wheel capture and camera controls.
- control.cpp ReadInput/MainTick and native ActionMoveInDirection::Start ->
  AISyncPvPDonorMovement.inl: kind9 direction/distance/rebase request plus native
  requested gait. AIMP's existing NativeRequestAdapter owns the strong Ref,
  scheduler admission, cancellation and destruction retirement.
- vent.cpp NearestVent, OnVentPickLeave, OnVentPickExitLeave -> native vent
  Update calls with a thread-scoped override of the Host-selected real opening.
- alien_extra.cpp ActAlienVoice -> existing replicated Roar adapter retained.
- donor attack entry is adapted to AIMP's Host-certified survivor target and
  existing paired-action replication; it never uses the parked technical body
  as an attack victim. Existing host attack availability/paired execution stays.

Android, facehugger, standalone multiplayer, photo mode, spawning/cloning,
global behavior-tree switches and the donor's BML are not installed. AIMP
owns its existing per-Alien lease and routes the donor's native requests there.
No shared Android/facehugger behavior branches are enabled.

Native contract references supplied in upstream dev/ghidra_dumps:
moveshut.txt, reqvt_012b19ac.txt, ventpick.txt, flank5.txt, disfb1.txt,
vt_move.txt. These are historical static evidence, not a recording of build435.
FollowUpdate and world-ray entry prologues were also checked against local
AI.exe with Capstone. The offline hook-installation tests verify compatibility.

In-game validation remains required for camera rendering, collision, native
gait transitions, vent connectivity and two-PC interaction animation timing.
